REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_AUTH}}.

REDIS_PORT.description: Port Redis listens on inside the container. Must stay 6379 — Langfuse references this port via private networking.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis hostname. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_HOST}} via private networking.
